Supplier.title: Supplier
Supplier.description: Represents a vendor or supplier with whom the business conducts transactions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Supplier entity.

name.description: The official name of the supplier.

personType.description: Type of person: 'Pessoa Física' or 'Pessoa Jurídica'.

cnpj.description: Tax ID (CNPJ or CPF) of the supplier.

contactName.description: Name of the primary contact person at the supplier.

email.description: Email address for contacting the supplier.

phone.description: Phone number for contacting the supplier.

category.description: General category or type of products/services provided by the supplier.

notes.description: Any additional notes or comments about the supplier.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was last updated.

AccountCategory.title: AccountCategory
AccountCategory.description: Defines a category within the chart of accounts, used for classifying financial transactions (e.g., 'Operacional > Insumos > Peixe').

id.description: Unique identifier for the AccountCategory entity.

name.description: The name of the account category (e.g., 'Peixe', 'Aluguel').

description.description: A detailed description of what the category represents.

type.description: The type of financial account, e.g., 'Revenue', 'Expense', 'Asset', 'Liability', 'Equity'.

code.description: An optional alphanumeric code for the account category, useful for hierarchical organization.

parentCategoryId.description: Reference to another AccountCategory entity, establishing a hierarchical relationship.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the account category record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the account category record was last updated.

CostCenter.title: CostCenter
CostCenter.description: Represents a business unit or department for detailed expense tracking.

name.description: The name of the cost center (e.g., 'Cozinha', 'Administrativo').

AccountsPayableEntry.title: AccountsPayableEntry
AccountsPayableEntry.description: Represents a single entry of an amount owed to a supplier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AccountsPayableEntry entity.

issueDate.description: The date the document was issued.

dueDate.description: The date when the payment is due.

paymentMethod.description: How the payment will be made (e.g., Pix, Boleto).
